acceptance.condition: A versioned deterministic generic attention contract and registry covers every H4A5 required attention family with exact per-family selector schemas, deterministic event identity, bounded serialization and rejection of unknown/malformed/substituted family or selector combinations.

The generic attention payload is selector-only: tests prove next_action, correction strategy/action, review verdict, roadmap successor, Executor/model/effort, executable command text and private browser binding fields cannot enter the transport contract.

Canonical RUN RESULT and FAILURE retain exact existing terminal provenance and enter respectively the semantic-review and correction-reasoning attention families without weakening H4A4 canonical freshness, dedupe or no-resend behavior.

Ingress/carrier rejection, review-ingress rejection, CHANGES_REQUIRED/BLOCKED review follow-up, and REMEDIATION/REPAIR authoring rejection each produce exactly one deterministic attention identity from their exact source selectors; PASS review does not masquerade as correction attention.

PRIMARY/REMEDIATION/REPAIR dispatch rejection and pre-AIOS operational failure coverage is derived from bounded carrier/admission/Operational Receipt evidence, preserves run_created=false when no RUN exists, and deterministic tests prove DISPATCH_ACCEPTED, RUNNER_STARTED and other ordinary progress do not wake.

Publication dispatch/execution failure, successful publication requiring Human/Brain planning, and canonical conflict/staleness each have exact source-bound attention projections; publication success never advances roadmap automatically and workflow status alone never substitutes for canonical reviewed/published identity.

All generic attention families enter the existing H4A4 per-project durable lane path and retain pre-send exact-source freshness, Human canonical supersession to resolved NOOP, independent-lane isolation, generation safety, one-flight ordering, ambiguity no-resend and safe duplicate-preserving compaction.

Wake-delivery recovery is bounded to an already unresolved original attention identity and cannot recursively create unbounded new attention subjects; malformed, stale, conflicting or missing source evidence fails closed without silently dropping the original attention.

Regression coverage proves the non-wake progress matrix, privacy/assistant-output exclusions, no generic semantic router, no pre-AIOS RUN/FAILURE fabrication, no actions-write/self-dispatch dependency for local wake delivery, and no downstream activation.

The candidate changes only TASK-authorized files and provides a bounded H4A5 Human conformance procedure for representative family emission, non-wake progress, stale-source suppression, two-lane delivery and recovery behavior without claiming live conformance or H4B resume has occurred.

Canonical roadmap selects H4A5 as the unique NEXT and Human binds TASK-279 revision 1 with Codex GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh for the entire task lifecycle.
Existing Operational Receipt v2 artifacts are subordinate operational evidence and may identify dispatch/pre-AIOS boundaries, but they are not canonical RUN/FAILURE truth.

hard: Define one repository-owned deterministic attention-family registry/projector with stable versioned family identifiers and per-family exact selector schemas; source workflows may supply bounded facts but may not each invent independent semantic classification rules.

Cover at least the canonical roadmap matrix: INGRESS_OR_CARRIER_REJECTION, PRIMARY_REMEDIATION_REPAIR_DISPATCH_REJECTION, PRE_AIOS_OPERATIONAL_FAILURE_REQUIRING_DIAGNOSIS, RUN_RESULT_REQUIRING_SEMANTIC_REVIEW, RUN_FAILURE_REQUIRING_CORRECTION_REASONING, REVIEW_INGRESS_REJECTION, REVIEW_CHANGES_REQUIRED_OR_BLOCKED, REMEDIATION_OR_REPAIR_AUTHORING_REJECTION, PUBLICATION_DISPATCH_OR_EXECUTION_FAILURE, PUBLICATION_SUCCESS_REQUIRING_HUMAN_BRAIN_PLANNING, CANONICAL_CONFLICT_OR_STALENESS, and WAKE_DELIVERY_RECOVERY_FOR_UNRESOLVED_ATTENTION.

Attention identity must be deterministic from family plus immutable exact source selectors sufficient for fresh reconstruction. The payload is selector-only and must reject next_action, verdict, correction action/strategy, roadmap successor, model/effort selection, free-form executable commands and private browser bindings.

Preserve the existing terminal RESULT/FAILURE source identity and map it into the generic family contract without weakening canonical artifact/ref validation, exact RUN binding or H4A4 dedupe/freshness semantics.

Pre-AIOS, carrier and workflow failures remain operational observations. Their attention event must explicitly preserve run_created=false where applicable and must never create or imply canonical FAILURE/RUN lineage.

Only source conditions that actually require Human/Brain semantic attention may enqueue. RUNNER_STARTED, executor/verification progress, DISPATCH_ACCEPTED, auto-publication start and equivalent progress boundaries must deterministically produce no wake.

Review follow-up must distinguish exact ingress rejection from canonical CHANGES_REQUIRED/BLOCKED decisions using immutable review/run selectors, without treating PASS as correction attention; successful publication may wake only as a planning-attention event and never auto-advance roadmap.
Publication failure attention must bind the exact review-decision/source RUN and failed publication attempt evidence without turning workflow conclusion alone into canonical publication truth.

Canonical conflict/staleness attention must bind the exact prepared subject and stale/conflicting canonical predecessor facts; it may request fresh reconstruction but may not choose a replacement task/candidate or retry action.

Every generic attention event must enter the existing H4A4 machine-local lane queue and inherit per-lane isolation, generation safety, one-flight rule, durable pre-submit deferral, post-submit ambiguity no-resend, exact outbound-user-turn proof, safe compaction and pre-send freshness barrier.

Freshness for each family must revalidate only its exact source selectors against canonical or bounded operational evidence and classify unresolved, resolved/superseded, or unknown/conflict. It must not run Brain Sync semantic flow selection or consume Unified State next_action.

Wake-delivery recovery attention must not recursively generate unbounded attention. Recovery events are deduped/bounded to the original unresolved attention identity and cannot create a second semantic subject.

Keep local wake/browser privacy guarantees unchanged: no assistant-output extraction, no chat-history scrape, no navigation, no draft clearing, no private binding material in GitHub payloads/artifacts.

Runtime remains canonical verification authority. Executor may add deterministic/synthetic workflow tests and a Human conformance procedure, but may not claim live ChatGPT delivery or Human planning reconciliation passed.
Executor changes are limited to the authorized modify surface. No roadmap mutation, semantic review, publication, downstream activation or live browser submission is part of implementation.

task.goal: Implement H4A5 complete Brain-attention-family coverage by generalizing the reviewed H4A4 local wake intake from terminal RESULT/FAILURE events to one bounded selector-only attention contract covering every approved attention family, while preserving durable lane semantics and keeping all semantic routing authority with fresh Brain Sync/Human/Brain.
non_goals: Implement H4B semantic Brain resume, automatically continue a lifecycle after wake, or parse assistant output/ACK content.
Encode or infer authoritative next_action, correction strategy, review verdict, roadmap successor, Executor, model, effort or publication decision in an attention event.
Fabricate a RUN, canonical FAILURE, REVIEW, REMEDIATION, REPAIR or publication artifact for a pre-AIOS/workflow/carrier failure.
Replace Runtime, Unified State, Reviewer, Publisher or Human/Brain planning with a generic attention router or event-sourced control plane.
Treat RUNNER_STARTED, Executor in-progress, Runtime verification in-progress, DISPATCH_ACCEPTED, auto-publication start or similar ordinary progress as wake-worthy events.
Broaden H4A4 browser inspection to assistant output or conversation-history scraping, weaken exact target/composer/Send/user-turn proof, or permit blind resend after ambiguous submission.
Commit machine-local chat/CDP/state bindings or provider/session secrets to the repository.
Activate or retarget downstream repositories such as Python Agent.
task.problem: After TASK-278, durable local wake delivery, lane isolation, pre-send freshness, ambiguity holds and generation-safe bindings are published, but the production event grammar is still terminal RESULT|FAILURE only. Important conditions such as ingress rejection, dispatch rejection, pre-AIOS operational failure, review follow-up, correction-authoring rejection, publication failure/success requiring planning, and canonical staleness can therefore require Human/Brain attention without entering the same durable exact-chat wake path. H4A5 must close that coverage gap with deterministic family identities and exact source selectors, while preventing ordinary progress signals or transport metadata from becoming semantic next-action authority.
